name: Psionic Assault
description: Blast your enemies with an array of offensive psionic powers. Your psionic damaging attacks have a chance to grant you Insight into your enemies. While you have Insight, your psionic damage powers cause additional psionic damage over time. Few living beings can resist their effects. Creatures without minds, however, like machines and robots, are much more resistant.

powers.name: Psionic Dart
powers.description: This basic attack does moderate psionic damage, and can slightly reduce a target's attack speed. Psionic Dart has a small chance to grant you insight. While you have insight, Psionic Dart will deal additional minor psionic damage over time. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Telekinetic Blow
powers.description: You project telekinetic energy around your fist before delivering a shattering uppercut to your foe dealing high Psionic and Smashing damage and sending them flying into the air. Telekinetic Blow has a high chance of granting you Insight. While you have Insight, Telekinetic Blow will deal additional minor psionic damage over time. Damage: High, Recharge: Moderate
powers.shortHelp: Melee, High DMG(Psionic/Smash), Foe Knock Up, Self +Insight

powers.name: Mental Blast
powers.description: This basic attack does high psionic damage, and can slightly reduce a target's attack speed. Mental Blast has a moderate chance to grant you Insight. While you have Insight, Mental Blast will deal additional minor psionic damage over time. Damage: High, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Psychic Scream
powers.description: This howl of psionic energy resonates in the minds of all foes within its conical area of effect inflicting moderate damage. Psychic Scream has a moderate chance to grant you Insight. If the caster has Insight when this power is used Psychic Scream will also cause a moderate amount of psionic damage over time. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Concentration
powers.description: Greatly boosts your attacks for a few seconds. Slightly increases chance to hit. Recharge: Long

powers.name: Mind Probe
powers.description: Grip the minds of your foe with a Mind Probe. You must be in close proximity to pull off this attack that wrecks havoc on your foes synapses, dealing high psionic damage while reducing their attack speed. Mind Probe has a high chance of granting you Insight. While you have Insight, Mind Probe will deal additional minor psionic damage over time. Damage: High, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Subdue
powers.description: Subdue deals high psionic damage and may leave the targeted foe immobilized for a brief time. Immobilized foes cannot move but can still attack. Subdue has a moderate chance to grant you Insight. While you have Insight, Subdue will deal additional minor psionic damage over time. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Moderate
powers.shortHelp: Ranged, High DMG(Psionic), Foe Immobilize; Self +Insight

powers.name: Psionic Lance
powers.description: This extremely long range psionic attack has a bonus to accuracy, and can slow a target's attack rate. This is a sniper attack, and is best fired from a distance, as it can be interrupted.  If you have more than 97% To-Hit, this attack becomes instant-cast. Psionic Lance will cause additional damage if you have Insight. Using this power removes Insight. Damage: Extreme, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Psychic Shockwave
powers.description: Psychic Shockwave is a devastating psionic attack that wracks the minds of all nearby foes. Affected foes may have a reduced attack rate and may be left disoriented. Psychic Shockwave has a moderate chance to grant you Insight. If the caster has Insight when this power is used Psychic Shockwave will also cause a moderate amount of psionic damage over time. Damage: Moderate Recharge: Slow
powers.shortHelp: PBAoE, Moderate DMG(Psionic), Foe Disorient -Recharge; Self +Insight
